headline: Phishing Surges and Students Push Back as Ed-Fi Summit Continues
thesis: With the Ed-Fi Summit midway through, security, student voice and evidence are shaping how schools and campuses adopt AI.
summary: THE Journal's Nov 9 report says cyber criminals are shifting to more targeted phishing attacks, a reminder for districts weighing AI and data-sharing tools. Inside Higher Ed's Nov 9 roundup shows UChicago's AI-free writing requirement, Eastern Illinois students petitioning for AI rules, and campus AI investments at Purdue, Rice, Iowa and Stanford. EdSurge examines whether AI can assess how well teachers notice student thinking, while the Ed-Fi Summit (Nov 9–11, Nashville) continues its focus on shared data.
footnote: Compiled from 11 curated edtech sources · NOVEMBER 10, 2026 · Built from search results only; direct site fetches were blocked in this environment, so several sources show recent or evergreen items rather than items dated today.
